name: SparSplat
aliases: SparSplat: Fast Multi-View Reconstruction with Generalizable 2D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A generalizable, feed-forward model that maps input images to planar surface elements (2DGS parameters) in a single forward pass to perform 3D shape reconstruction and novel view synthesis from sparse-view images.
summary: SparSplat is a fast, generalizable model that maps sparse images to 2D Gaussian Splatting parameters for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis using planar primitives.
